notes.title: Days Gone Patch 1.12 Notes
notes.notes:
PERFORMANCE

Crash fixes and streaming optimizations.

GENERAL

The intro videos will automatically skip if the player has a main menu save file.

Made an adjustment that prevents the Screensaver/Sleep mode from kicking in if players idle in the game.

Update to how the Input Remapping functions to correctly handle all window closing logic.

Fixed an issue so the vibration slider properly changes on the Steam Deck.

Fixed an issue where female Freakers were spawning at a higher rate out of nests.

Fixed inaccessible Growler locations in NG+.

Fixed an issue where the icons wouldn't update properly when trying to refuel or repair at camp Mechanics.

Updates to the Touchpad deadzone.

Fixed an issue where the screen may flash black randomly.

Fixed an issue where in some instances players were able to control Deacon while on the main menu.

Corrected an instance where the player would end up in the Options menu when selecting Continue on the main menu.

Updated text in Options menu that XP Indicators are only available in Story mode.

Updated all game modes to use consistent language.

Mini-map updates to properly remove icons.

HORDE ASSAULT

Fixed an issue with the focus bar staying on screen after use.

Any set waypoints will be removed upon choosing to reset the current map.

Freakers will now explode when killed with Throwables. Molotov responsibly.

Supply Box interacts will update if the Target Score is achieved while standing next to it.

The Open a Supply Box side job is now properly disabled during Ultimate Horde phase.

PERMADEATH

After completing Permadeath, player save files will convert to normal saves in the epilogue.

End screen graphics for Permadeath and Speedrun modes will now provide accurate stats.

Fixed Permadeath saves to be unable to load after dying.

PHOTO MODE

Adaptive triggers are no longer active while in Photo Mode.

The default value of Bloom Max Intensity has been adjusted properly.

Fixed Time of Day slider to properly reset when the player holds the Touchpad.

ACCESSIBILITY

Fixed an issue where explosive bolts would leave a black square on the screen in High Contrast Mode.

Game Speed settings will now be consistent in game modes and during weapon wheel use.

 

If you are experiencing any issues, please Submit a Request to 

support.bendstudio.com.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support.

notes.title: Days Gone Patch 1.10 Notes
notes.notes:
Build 18552152

PERFORMANCE

 Various crash fixes.

AUDIO

 Overall audio mix improved.
 Various audio adjustments. 
 Fixed occasional loud sound volumes when riding the bike.
 Improved dialogue volumes, specifically for the survivor hostage events.
 Enemy weapons improved to sound more threatening.
 Freakers sound louder when near the player.
 Grappling a Freaker sounds more intense.

CONTROLS

 Motion Sensor Function Aiming (gyro aiming) is working as intended.
 Adaptive Trigger intensity sliders in the menu are now working as intended.
 Strength of resistance while riding the bike has been reduced.
Dev note: We cut the intensity in half for a more comfortable ride across the Broken Road.

HORDE ASSAULT (DLC)

 Fixed horde navigation issues in some areas.
 UI improvements in Horde Assault.
Dev note: Specifically, for players using the 16:10 aspect ratio and on the Steam Deck.

OTHER

 Localization updates.
 Fixed an animation conflict that could cause Deacon to launch into the air for long distances.

We are still investigating the intro movies stuttering for some players. Thank you for your patience as we work on getting this resolved.

If you are experiencing any issues, please Submit a Request to support.bendstudio.com.

notes.title: Days Gone Patch 1.09 Notes
notes.notes:
Build 18403805

PERFORMANCE

 Fixed an issue where the game would get into an infinite initial load over bad resolution settings. This was preventing players from getting to the main menu. 
Dev note: We recommend to double check the resolution settings in the Display tab to ensure desired output.

 Various crash fixes related to the GPU and dying in a specific mission on Permadeath mode. (DLC)

AUDIO

 Fixed an audio crash that occurred when the game was running while the PC went into sleep mode.
 Fixed an audio issue which led to excessively loud sound volumes. 
 Fixed an audio issue preventing a sound from looping when playing Horde Assault for longer than 30 minutes. (DLC)

OTHER

 Fixed an issue where the Unreal logo was showing as the icon on the toolbar instead of Days Gone.
Dev note: Issue may persist until local icon cache is updated.


If you are experiencing any issues, please Submit a Request to support.bendstudio.com.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support. We will have further updates in the near future.

notes.title: Days Gone Update is Live

notes.title: UPDATE (7/23/21): Days Gone PC - Known Issues
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are currently investigating the following issues that have been impacting some players with Days Gone on PC:

 Issues with a lack of controller input. If you are not receiving any controller input, please follow these steps: Make sure ‘Ignore Controller’ is turned off in the Options > Controller menu. Make sure only one controller is connected in windows. Try clicking left mouse into the game window to give the game windows focus
 Audio issues, including loss of audio at initial launch
 Simultaneous mouse and keyboard/gamepad input conflicting with rolling/sprinting actions
 Problems with turning in bounties or meat, while also unable to properly interact at other vendors
 Unable to equip weapons from the player Gun Locker with controller
 Game hang when the cinematic starts before the mission ‘What’s A Nice Girl’
 Intermittent crashes when booting the game or in the early game
 Intermittent issues with game speed/stutters
 Ghosting/decal rendering, including tire tracks and footprints
 Unable to craft molotovs
 HDR option is locked out for some players with HDR monitors

We are aware of the concern expressed by some players about the Data Collection Policy. Any personal information in the telemetry data is completely anonymized unless you specifically agree to Full & Limited Data.

Thank you all for sharing your feedback across our channels, and showing your incredible support with our Days Gone PC launch. Our team is continuing to monitor all issues and we will update you when more news is available. See you on the Broken Road!

Make sure only one controller is connected in windows. Try clicking left mouse into the game window to give the game windows focus.

notes.title: FIXED: Update on PC Controller Issue
notes.notes:
We are aware that some players have been experiencing controller issues with steering the bike in Steam versions of Days Gone, and we've identified the issue in the currently uploaded configurations. We are working to fix this immediately to ensure you receive full controller support as promised. We are sorry for any inconvenience this has caused our affected players and we appreciate your support and patience.

UPDATE: We are glad to report that the controller issue with steering the bike in Steam versions of Days Gone has been resolved. In order for the update to take effect, please close Days Gone and restart Steam. If you changed to a community controller configuration, you need to change back to the official configuration. Thank you again for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy Days Gone on PC!

- Bend Studio

notes.title: Days Gone PC release date and features have been revealed
notes.notes:
If you're champing at the bit to get on the road with Deacon St. John on PC, you've only got about another month left to wait: Days Gone, the formerly PlayStation-exclusive open-world zombie game, is set to launch on PC on May 18. Sony has revealed some of the new features that will be arriving alongside Deacon and his chopper when they arrive on Steam and the Epic Games Store next month.
There's a brand-new PC trailer to check out if you'd like to see the new features in action, and that's included below. First on the list is support for ultra-wide 21:9 monitors, which will let you take in the full breadth of a 500-zombie swarm. You'll also be able to customise your control scheme, using first- and third-party control pads as well as keyboard and mouse as inputs. New graphics options will let you dial the level of detail up to 11 if you've got hardware headspace to spare.
Developer Bend Studio has also added a super resolution photo mode to Days Gone for the PC release. There are no specifics on how exactly this works, but generally speaking, 'super resolution' images are composites of several lower-resolution images, using the best information in each one to form the higher-quality final image.
